name: Mary Shelleys Frankenstein VR Story
summary:
This experience brings the atmosphere of a classic slide-show evening into virtual reality. Instead of sitting in front of a wall while someone presents pictures and tells the story, you are surrounded by each scene and guided through it by spoken narration.

Follow Victor Frankenstein from his youth in Geneva to his studies in Ingolstadt, the creation of the Creature, its search for understanding, and the chain of rejection, guilt, and revenge that ends in the frozen Arctic. Stand inside candlelit laborato
